notes.title: Announcement: Price Change and Name Change
notes.notes:
The game will transition from free to paid.
The name will change to "Pet for Mistress".
I will add a richer and deeper backstory to the game. The content will include adult themes, but it is not an adult game.
The main gameplay will be retained, including combat, forging, and managing a farm.
The backstory will provide a reasonable motivation for the players' actions.
